Kudos & Open Biblical Scholarship Credits

Grateful acknowledgment to the scholars, open-license ministries, and online tools that make LexFlow possible

Everything stays inside LexFlow for a seamless study experience, built on the shoulders of generous biblical scholars and open-licensed projects. Use any of the external arrow links (↗) below if you ever wish to explore their home websites directly.

SRGNT & Center for New Testament Restoration (CNTR)

Dr. Alan Bunning • CC BY 4.0
CNTR ↗

The Statistical Restoration Greek New Testament (SRGNT) (also the Bunning Heuristic Prototype underlying the unfoldingWord® Greek New Testament) provides the open-licensed Greek text, lexical lemmas, and Enhanced Strong’s tagging at the core of LexFlow.

unfoldingWord® Greek (UGG) & Hebrew (UHG) Grammars

unfoldingWord & Door43 Community • CC BY-SA 4.0
UGG ↗ UHG ↗

Open-licensed reference grammars built around the exact morphological categories of the UGNT/SRGNT and OpenScriptures Hebrew Bible. Original works available via unfoldingWord.org ↗.

OpenScriptures Hebrew Bible (MorphHB) & WLC

OpenScriptures & Groves Center • CC BY 4.0 / Public Domain
OSHB ↗

Provides the Westminster Leningrad Codex (WLC) Hebrew Old Testament text with word-level morphological parsing codes (morphhb) and Strong’s Hebrew & Greek dictionary datasets.

MorphGNT & SBL Greek New Testament

James Tauber, Dr. Michael W. Holmes, SBL & Logos • CC BY-SA
MorphGNT ↗

Provides the full-canon Greek New Testament morphological parsing database (part of speech, person, tense, voice, mood, case, number, gender, and lemmas).

EMTV New Testament & Berean Standard Bible (BSB)

Paul Esposito (EMTV) & Berean.bible (BSB Public Domain)
BSB ↗

Provides the clear, literal modern English translations for the New Testament (English Majority Text Version) and Old Testament (Berean Standard Bible, plus WEB, ASV, KJV & YLT public-domain comparisons via Bolls.life).

comparisons via Bolls.life).

Thayer’s Greek & Brown-Driver-Briggs (BDB) Hebrew Lexicons

J.H. Thayer, F. Brown, S.R. Driver, C.A. Briggs & J. Strong
Bible Hub ↗

Classic lexical authorities providing root derivations, semantic ranges, and contextual usage across the Hebrew Old Testament and Greek New Testament.

Online Biblical Grammar & Layperson Pedagogy Resources

Accessible Greek & Hebrew Teaching for Laypeople, Students & Pastors
Bill Mounce ↗ NTGreek.org ↗ Aleph with Beth ↗ Alpha with Angela ↗ Daily Dose Greek ↗ Daily Dose Hebrew ↗
